exposure: oxygen requirement during mechanical ventilation (low oxygen <=30%, high oxygen >30%)
cohort: The study included 20 preterm neonates with severe respiratory distress (gestational age 32.2 ± 3 weeks) who were under mechanical ventilation in their first two days of life.
finding: In the high oxygen group, plasma levels of IL-6, IL-8, and TNF-a significantly increased after two hours under mechanical ventilation.
followup_time: Observations were taken within the first two days of life, specifically 2 hours after the initiation of mechanical ventilation.
